profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI Development Engineer | Cloud Migration Specialist
profile.summary:
Results-driven Software Engineer with experience in full-stack development and AI, specializing in enterprise health data analytics and financial applications. Proven track record of delivering high-impact solutions. Skilled in artificial intelligence, cloud migration, microservices architecture, containerization, and database optimization. Demonstrated leadership in growing and mentoring engineering teams, fostering
collaboration, and implementing best practices. Committed to continuous improvement and innovation, evidenced by winning company AI Hackathon and winning a spot in the AI Mentorship program that greatly elevated my AI skills by being paired with AI/ML expert. Adept at balancing technical excellence with business
objectives, consistently delivering scalable, secure, and efficient solutions in fast-paced environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Client: Citi Group

Deployed critical payments infrastructure and autonomous AI testing agents for a top-tier financial institution.

● Architected an Autonomous AI Testing Agent utilizing Claude Sonnet 4.5 to autonomously analyze repositories and generate meaningful test cases. Raised test coverage by 40%, enabling the team to meet strict regulatory quality gates without increasing manual headcount.

● Engineered Real-Time Transaction Filters for the Zelle payments network, processing millions of transactions. Designed low-latency filtering logic for historical and current transaction data to enhance user experience (UX) and fraud detection capability.

● Integrated strict financial compliance mandates into distributed services, ensuring zero-defect delivery for high-volume payment processing.
positions.insights: Skills: Go · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · React.js · Angular · Java · Microservices · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · GitHub · Cloud Infrastructure · Cloud Services · Software Design · Cloud Automation

positions.title: Application Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Lead full-stack development initiatives for enterprise health data analytics applications.
Projects include cloud migration efforts, optimizing application performance, and driving
innovation through AI and machine learning projects. Instrumental in scaling services
nationally and improving infrastructure reliability.

● Led the development of new features for enterprise health data analytics application,
directly contributing to over $200 million in revenue within two years of production.

● Orchestrated the successful migration of a critical application from on-premises to
AWS, achieving 99.9999% reliability through multi-region replication.

● Built a "Human-in-the-Loop" AI Document Pipeline for HEDIS compliance. Ingested raw medical records (PDFs) and utilized NLP models to pre-fill HEDIS forms, highlighting data provenance within the source document transforming the Abstractor role from complex manual search to rapid judgment/validation, increasing throughput by 35%.

● Won Corporate AI Hackathon by designing and deploying a production-ready RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) application for contract parsing using Cohere embeddings and OpenAI.

● Developed and maintained high-performance APIs using Golang, processing over
two million records daily.

● Implemented containerization and orchestration of microservices using Docker and Kubernetes, enabling scalability to handle users across all 50 states.

● Spearheaded refactoring of legacy code, transitioning from MongoDB and GraphQL
to PostgreSQL and REST, significantly improving data processing efficiency.

● Grew the team from 4 to 18 members over two years, serving as the most tenured
engineer and fostering high collaboration among team members.

● Established and maintained an SLA process ensuring 99.99% application reliability,
and created a robust disaster recovery plan.
positions.insights: Skills: Go · React.js · JavaScript · Node.js · Angular · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · SQL · Git · Java

development workflow and productivity

● Contributed to the development of a new application website, integrating complex business
